name: Romance
description: Declarative romance preset. Desire, barrier, and earned intimacy; no living-author imitation.
purpose: Make the central relationship the plot engine, with a barrier that only change can remove.
writing_goals: Give both (or all) partners interior wants that conflict
Put a specific barrier between them
Let intimacy be earned by risk and recognition, not proximity alone
constraints: Do not imitate a living author
Use abstract narrative style, not a named living voice
Conflict that could be solved by one honest sentence with no cost
A partner's personality reversing for the ending
Intimacy used as a pause button on plot
checklist: The barrier is named and remains until paid down
Each lead has agency in the turning scenes
Public consequences of the relationship are tracked
The ending state matches the promises the story made

pacing_tendency.value: attraction and retreat cycles; set-piece conversations carry turns

description_tendency.value: body, space, and private ritual; public vs private settings matter

dialogue_tendency.value: subtext-heavy; banter must still move the barrier
